scope: One bounded independent, unscored mechanical verification of comparison, adjudication, source binding, exact helper freeze and first-save locking.
method: Executed only the three inspected Python sources in memory, with bytecode disabled. Pure checks used deep copies of the allowed synthetic capacity body. Prepare/lock tests used removed TemporaryDirectory roots, an explicit no-op ready mock and synthetic events. Actual adjudication ready was separately exercised against temporary four-file freeze placeholders with an explicit base-freeze mock. No live admission was asserted.

findings.evidence: A structurally valid pair with correctly hashed outputs and prepared sources was accepted when both native_terminal_join events had terminal_observed=false.
findings.required: Require actual observed terminal witnesses for both independent reviews before complete comparison or locking.

findings.evidence: Lock accepted an adjudicator terminal/output hash while its job_prepared input binding for the exact dispute report was deliberately stale. Lock never checks that prepared binding.
findings.required: Bind and verify the native adjudicator's exact dispute/source inputs, as well as its actual terminal and output hash.

findings.evidence: Deterministic interleaving inserted a concurrent first save immediately after the existence assertion; lock's write_text overwrote it. The other first-save paths use the same check-then-write pattern.
findings.required: Use atomic exclusive creation or a no-replace publication mechanism; retain the first saved bytes.

findings.evidence: A declared retention_rows.relation disagreement was correctly classified scalar, but legal resolved value lost was rejected: relation has no allowed enum here.
findings.required: Allow the original typed retention relation enum for this declared scalar field.

findings.evidence: An unresolved resolution without a value member was accepted because get('value') returns None. Explicit null succeeds, but omission is not distinguished.
findings.required: Require the declared resolution members and an explicitly present null for unresolved.

findings.evidence: An invalid independent review correctly gated comparison and invented no grades, but emitted rows=[], dropping every explicit expected row identity rather than retaining 210 null assessment rows.
findings.required: Retain explicit planned identities/fixed fields with null semantic assessments, or provide an equally explicit gated identity disposition.

freeze_observation: The exact four-file adjudication freeze rejects missing, extra, duplicate, drifting and nonpass verification entries. Runtime source inspection shows exact required source coverage including runtime and review validation helpers. Future real generation/adjudication freezes were neither read nor admitted.
preservation: All ten inspected real files remained byte-identical through the synthetic checks. Only this report is saved in the run tree; temporary roots were removed.
authority_ceiling: Capacity packet/review are unscored fixture evidence only. No G output, scored packet/review, parent history, web or other agent was read. No live job output, source repair, experimental observation, semantic grade, method effect or production readiness is asserted.
